title: Geographically Regularized AUC-Maximizing Personalized Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.08379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate diagnostic and risk-prediction models are important for supporting clinical decision-making during infectious disease outbreaks. However, privacy and governance requirements may restrict patient-level data sharing across healthcare institutions, and data distributions often vary. Moreover, AUC is widely used to evaluate discriminative performance, motivating its direct optimization in model development. We propose geographically regularized AUC-maximizing personalized federated learning (GrAUC-PFL), which directly optimizes a smooth pairwise AUC surrogate to learn personalized models while keeping patient-level data local and accounting for institutional heterogeneity. Graph-based regularization encourages geographically neighboring institutions to have similar coefficient vectors while retaining a personalized models. translated_title: 地理正则化的AUC最大化个性化联邦学习
translated_abstract: 准确的诊断和风险预测模型对于在传染病暴发期间支持临床决策至关重要。然而，隐私和治理要求可能限制跨医疗机构的患者级数据共享，且数据分布往往存在差异。此外，AUC被广泛用于评估判别性能，这促使在模型开发中直接对其进行优化。我们提出了地理正则化的AUC最大化个性化联邦学习，该方法直接优化平滑的成对AUC替代函数来学习个性化模型，同时将患者级数据保留在本地并考虑机构间的异质性。基于图的正则化鼓励地理上相邻的机构拥有相似的系数向量，同时保留个性化模型。仿真实验和真实数据应用表明，该方法的判别性能得到提升，尤其是在地理……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了GrAUC-PFL方法，通过直接优化平滑的成对AUC替代损失，并结合基于图的正则化使地理相邻机构模型相似，在患者数据不出本地、兼顾机构异质性的前提下学习个性化模型，从而提升传染病诊断与风险预测的判别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GrAUC-PFL, which directly optimizes a smooth pairwise AUC surrogate with graph-based geographic regularization, learning personalized federated models that keep patient data local and account for institutional heterogeneity to improve discriminative performance in infectious disease diagnosis and risk prediction.
